title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Scandal
subtitle: The leader of the world's most important AI company steps down after reports of affairs and security concerns.

summary.en: Jensen Huang has officially resigned as the CEO of Nvidia after reports of personal affairs surfaced. One of these relationships involved a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. The company has appointed Colette Kress as the interim leader while they search for a permanent replacement. Despite the scandal, many tech leaders have expressed support for Huang's past achievements. The situation has raised serious questions about national security and the future of the company.
summary.zh: 黃仁勳在個人婚外情報導浮上檯面後，已正式辭去輝達執行長職務。其中一段關係涉及一名被指控為中國間諜的女子。公司已任命克蕾絲擔任代理領導人，同時尋找永久接替人選。儘管醜聞纏身，許多科技領袖仍對黃仁勳過去的成就表示支持。此事件已引發關於國家安全與公司未來的嚴重質疑。

paragraphs.en: Jensen Huang, the long-time leader of the chipmaking giant Nvidia, resigned on Thursday. His departure marks a sudden end to his time at the head of one of the world's most influential technology companies. The resignation follows a series of reports regarding his personal life, including claims of extramarital affairs. According to The Guardian, the company board accepted his resignation effective immediately, though their official statement focused on his "profound" contributions to the industry rather than the scandal.
paragraphs.zh: 長期領導晶片製造巨頭輝達（Nvidia）的黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）於週四辭職。他的離去為他執掌這家全球最具影響力科技公司之一的時期，畫下了突如其來的句點。此次辭職發生在一系列關於他私生活的報導之後，其中包括婚外情的指控。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，公司董事會已接受他立即生效的辭呈，儘管官方聲明將重點放在他對產業的「深遠」貢獻，而非這起醜聞。

paragraphs.en: The situation began to unfold in late October. The New York Times reported that Huang had a close relationship with a woman at a Singapore-based company that purchased Nvidia chips. U.S. intelligence officials reportedly believed this woman was recruited by Chinese intelligence to spy on the CEO. While China’s foreign ministry has called these claims a "smear campaign," the reports caused significant concern regarding national security. As NPR noted, the situation grew more complicated when further reports suggested Huang had a second affair with an employee at his own company.
paragraphs.zh: 這起事件始於十月下旬。據《紐約時報》（The New York Times）報導，黃仁勳與一家購買輝達晶片的新加坡公司的一名女性關係密切。據傳美國情報官員認為，該名女子是被中國情報單位吸收，以對這位執行長進行間諜活動。雖然中國外交部稱這些指控為「抹黑行動」，但相關報導已引發對國家安全的重大擔憂。正如美國國家公共電台（NPR）所指出的，當後續報導暗示黃仁勳與自家公司的一名員工還有第二段婚外情時，情況變得更加複雜。

paragraphs.en: Following the news, Nvidia’s stock price dropped sharply. On Thursday, shares fell by 14% when the market opened, though they later recovered slightly to finish 4% lower. The company has now appointed Colette Kress, their chief financial officer, to lead the business on an interim basis—a temporary role until a permanent replacement is found. The board of directors stated they will look at both internal and external candidates to fill the position.
paragraphs.zh: 消息傳出後，輝達股價大幅下跌。週四開盤時股價重挫百分之十四，隨後小幅回升，最終收跌百分之四。公司目前已任命財務長克蕾絲（Colette Kress）擔任代理執行長，在找到永久接替人選前暫代職務。董事會表示，將同時考量內部與外部人選來填補該職位。

paragraphs.en: The implications of this scandal extend beyond the company. Because Nvidia dominates the market for chips used in artificial intelligence, Huang’s leadership was considered essential to the global tech economy. According to NPR, the fact that the White House may have known about these allegations for weeks has led to calls for a formal investigation when the new Congress meets in January. Representative Yvette Clarke told NPR that the situation is "very disturbing" and requires further attention.
paragraphs.zh: 這起醜聞的影響已超出公司本身。由於輝達在人工智慧晶片市場占據主導地位，黃仁勳的領導被視為全球科技經濟不可或缺的一環。根據 NPR 報導，白宮可能早在數週前就已知曉這些指控的事實，已引發外界呼籲在明年一月新國會開議時進行正式調查。聯邦眾議員克拉克（Yvette Clarke）向 NPR 表示，此情況「非常令人不安」，需要進一步關注。

paragraphs.en: Despite the serious nature of the allegations, many prominent figures in the technology industry have defended Huang. On social media, several leaders expressed that his resignation was a mistake or an overreaction. The Verge reported that Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney called it a "sad day" for the industry, praising Huang’s vision. Similarly, some tech leaders argued that his personal life should not have resulted in his removal from the company he helped build 33 years ago.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管指控性質嚴重，科技界許多知名人士仍為黃仁勳辯護。在社群媒體上，幾位領導者表示他的辭職是一個錯誤或過度反應。《The Verge》報導，Epic Games 執行長史威尼（Tim Sweeney）稱這是產業「悲傷的一天」，並讚揚黃仁勳的遠見。同樣地，一些科技領袖認為，他的私生活不應導致他被逐出他三十三年前協助創立的公司。

paragraphs.en: President Donald Trump also commented on the situation. While he initially defended Huang, he later suggested that Tim Cook, the leader of Apple, should take over the role. "A Legend replaces a Legend!" Trump posted on social media. Other names, such as Rene Haas of Arm Holdings and Lisa Su of AMD, have also been mentioned as potential candidates for the job, though no clear successor has been named yet.
paragraphs.zh: 川普（Donald Trump）總統也對此發表評論。雖然他起初為黃仁勳辯護，但後來建議由蘋果（Apple）領導人庫克（Tim Cook）接手該職位。川普在社群媒體上發文稱：「傳奇取代傳奇！」其他名字，如安謀（Arm Holdings）的哈斯（Rene Haas）和超微（AMD）的蘇姿丰（Lisa Su）也被提及為潛在候選人，儘管目前尚未公布明確的接班人。

paragraphs.en: This leadership change puts Nvidia in a difficult position. As Stephen Witt, author of a book about the company, explained to NPR, it is hard to imagine the business without Huang, who was a central figure in its growth. The company is now facing a period of high uncertainty. With the board searching for a new leader and the possibility of government investigations into what the White House knew, the coming months will be a major test for the chipmaker.
paragraphs.zh: 這次領導層變動使輝達陷入困境。正如該公司傳記作者威特（Stephen Witt）向 NPR 解釋的那樣，很難想像沒有黃仁勳的輝達，因為他是公司成長的核心人物。公司目前正面臨高度不確定的時期。隨著董事會尋找新領導人，加上政府可能針對白宮已知情內容進行調查，未來幾個月將是對這家晶片製造商的重大考驗。

paragraphs.en: For now, the company is trying to maintain stability. Nvidia still plans to report its quarterly earnings next week, which will be a key moment for investors to see how the business is performing without its founder. While the board has thanked Huang for his work in building the company into a global leader, the focus has now shifted entirely to the search for a new CEO who can manage both the company’s complex technology and the intense public pressure that follows this scandal.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，公司正試圖維持穩定。輝達仍計畫於下週公布季度財報，這將是投資人觀察公司在失去創辦人後表現的關鍵時刻。雖然董事會感謝黃仁勳將公司打造為全球領導者的貢獻，但焦點現在已完全轉向尋找一位能同時管理公司複雜技術，並應對醜聞後巨大公眾壓力的執行長。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To develop or become known gradually.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「打開（摺疊物）」，這裡指事件的發展。文中：The situation began to unfold in late October.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Temporary; intended to last only until a permanent replacement is found.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞在商業新聞中常出現，容易被誤認為是名詞或特定職位名稱。文中：The company has now appointed Colette Kress, their chief financial officer, to lead the business on an interim basis—a temporary role until a permanent replacement is found.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A difficult situation that shows how strong or capable someone or something is.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「考試」，這裡指對公司穩定性的嚴峻挑戰。文中：the coming months will be a major test for the chipmaker.

quiz.question: What happened to Nvidia's stock price on the day Jensen Huang's resignation was announced?

options.A: It dropped by 4% and remained at that level for the entire day.
options.B: It fell by 14% at the market opening but recovered to close with a 4% loss.
options.C: It experienced a steady decline of 14% throughout the entire trading day.
options.D: It remained stable because investors were already anticipating the resignation.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，股票在市場開盤時下跌了 14%，隨後稍微回升，最終以下跌 4% 作收。選項 A 錯誤，因為 4% 是收盤時的跌幅，而非全天維持不變。選項 C 錯誤，因為 14% 是開盤時的瞬間跌幅，而非整日的跌幅。選項 D 與事實不符，市場對此消息反應劇烈，股價並未保持穩定。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the US government be interested in investigating this scandal?

options.A: Because the government wants to acquire Nvidia's artificial intelligence technology.
options.B: Because they are concerned about the moral conduct of tech CEOs in the industry.
options.C: Because there are concerns that the CEO's personal relationships may have compromised national security.
options.D: Because they want to ensure that Colette Kress is qualified to lead the company.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段與第四段，情報官員認為與黃仁勳有往來的女子可能受中國情報機構指使進行間諜活動，這引發了國家安全疑慮。第四段進一步提到，由於白宮可能早已知情，國會要求進行正式調查。選項 A 文中未提；選項 B 雖涉及道德，但政府介入的主因是國安問題；選項 D 與調查動機無關。

quiz.question: In the second paragraph, what does the phrase 'smear campaign' mean in the context of China's response to the allegations?

options.A: A deliberate effort to damage someone's reputation with false or misleading information.
options.B: A formal legal procedure to investigate the financial records of a foreign company.
options.C: A strategic marketing plan to promote a new product in the international market.
options.D: A diplomatic attempt to strengthen ties between two competing global powers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。Smear campaign 指的是「抹黑行動」，即透過散布負面或虛假訊息來毀損他人名譽。文中提到中國外交部稱這些指控為「抹黑行動」，意指他們認為這些關於間諜活動的說法是刻意針對他們的毀謗。選項 B、C、D 皆與「抹黑」的定義無關，且不符合該詞彙在政治與新聞語境中的負面意涵。
